## Findings
- [ ] **[Coverage/WARN] `SymairaOnboardingScaffold` view body has low line coverage**
  - **Status quo:** `Sources/SymairaTheme/Onboarding.swift` line coverage is 23.17% (126 of 164 lines uncovered). The state machine (`SymairaOnboardingFlow`) itself is fully exercised by `Tests/SymairaThemeTests/OnboardingTests.swift`; the uncovered lines are the SwiftUI `View` body (`SymairaOnboardingScaffold.body`, `progressIndicator`, `navigationBar`, the accessibility-announcement closure).
  - **Likely cause:** This repo's XCTest setup has no SwiftUI view-hosting harness, so `View` bodies are structurally uncovered everywhere (`Components.swift` 4.24%, `FeedbackComponents.swift` 55.10%, `FormComponents.swift` 78.21% follow the same pattern) — this is not specific to the new onboarding scaffold.
  - **Proposed solution:** Out of scope for this release: adding a SwiftUI view-hosting/snapshot harness is a repo-wide test-infrastructure investment, not a per-PR fix. No action needed before this release; consider a follow-up issue if view-level coverage becomes a priority.
  - **Uncovered:** `Sources/SymairaTheme/Onboarding.swift:129-197` (view body, in `SymairaOnboardingScaffold.body`/`progressIndicator`/`navigationBar`/`announce(position:)`)
  - **Effort/Impact:** Medium effort (repo-wide harness) / Low impact (state machine — the actual flow logic — is already fully tested)
